paragraphs.text: Ol' Buzzbark is a legendary goblin warrior from Bablovia in the Un-iverse . Ol' Buzzbark was introduced as a character in Unstable as the alpha goblin of the Goblin Explosioneers . He is not quite the leader but is very destructive and thus quite popular among the Explosioneers. He is a goblin with an extremely large nose and ears. He has a wooden weapon system attached around his arms and shoulders. One of his arms has been replaced with a large spinning saw.
